General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Genuine OEM Part
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the OEM Brake Proportioning Valve for Suzuki Cultus/Baleno. Internal valves are the same as a Suzuki Samurai. Requires a valve swap from Cultus/Baleno to Samurai housing. Fixes leaking valve due to warn out valve seals.
Requires modification for correct fitment
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Brake Proportioning Valve
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
CULTUS/BALENO
